tasks.label: Build Imp Lab (Windows)
tasks.detail: Cross-compile portable imp-lab.exe plus the Aura pack via editor-windows into AURA_EDITOR_WIN_OUT. Works on the WSL host or attached in the Dev Container.

tasks.label: Assemble Aura pack (Linux)
tasks.detail: Build the aura-engine pack cdylibs and the aura-editor UI library in the imp-lab service and assemble the Aura pack into .aura-pack/.
